turns.user_utterance: The ATM at Metro bank on High St. Kensington didn't return my card. What should I do now that the bank is closed?
turns.assistant_response: I’m sorry—if an ATM swallowed your card, the right next step is to contact your card provider/ATM support to start a card recovery request, then keep your bank’s ATM receipt/reference number handy. Since the bank is closed, do you have the ATM receipt or reference number, and was the transaction completed or shown as declined/pending?
